claims.normalizedValue: Between March 14 and March 15, 2025 mutable tags of tj-actions/changed-files were retroactively pointed at commit 0e58ed8671d6b60d0890c21b07f8835ace038e67, whose code read runner process memory and wrote encoded output into workflow logs; the maintainers repaired the tags and removed the object. The published period is date-level with no clock time or timezone, so this pack encodes UTC calendar days as a labeled conservative expansion. The three named tags are examples from the maintainer advisory and are not an exhaustive inventory; no known-good identity is encoded because the primary sources disagree on the first patched version; and no log literal or domain is encoded because none is stated as a reliable victim-log indicator.
